story.title: One wedding.
story.text: You will receive an invitation, a role, and a reason to dress up. The rest will happen naturally — over dinner, music, and conversations late into the night.

seo.heading: Fake Wedding: a unique way to spend an evening in Riga
seo.description: A theatrical role-playing social event for adults: meet new people, take on a role, share conversations and enjoy a memorable evening in Riga. Ideal for anyone looking for a unique party, fun things to do and new connections.

privacy.title: Personal Data Processing Policy
privacy.lead: Here, in plain language, we explain what data we use and how we protect it with care.
privacy.asideText: We use your data only to organise your participation in the event and improve the website.

sections.title: What data we collect
sections.text: When you submit an invitation request, we process your name, email address and phone number. With your consent to analytics cookies, Google Analytics may collect technical and aggregated data, such as pages visited, actions on the website, device type, browser, approximate location and traffic source. We do not use this data to identify you directly.

sections.title: How we use data
sections.text: Data is used to process your request, communicate about the Fake Wedding event and send organisational information. Aggregated analytics data helps us understand which pages and materials are useful, improve the website experience and provide better communication with clients.

sections.title: Google Analytics and cookies
sections.text: We use Google Analytics only after you give consent in the cookie banner. The service sets analytics cookies and processes data on our behalf to produce visitor statistics. You can decline analytics by selecting “Decline” in the banner; this does not affect the core functions of the website. Google processes data under its own

sections.title: Legal basis for processing
sections.text: We process contact data based on the consent you provide by ticking the checkbox in the form. Analytics data is processed only after separate consent through the cookie banner. You can withdraw consent at any time by clearing site data in your browser or contacting us.

sections.title: Retention and protection
sections.text: We retain request data only as long as necessary to organise the event and communicate about your request. Analytics data retention is set in Google Analytics. We use reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect data.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.text: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data, as well as restrict its processing. To exercise these rights, contact us by phone

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this policy, including when the services we use change. The current version is always published on this page.
